contract.repeat: Three repeats plus JSON persistence retain ID, five keyed catalog rows, values, complete primary/qualification sources and generated notes, catalog origin and deductibleClassification override.
contract.document_priority: Within manual/catalog context, exact Utleie choice heading or local Valg/Valgstatus/Status/Dekning inside documented Utleie addon may assert selected/refused/unknown; selected+refused yields unknown/conflict. Explicit unknown without selected blocks manual fallback. Description/detail/supporting evidence never chooses parent. Invalid manual proof cannot be rescued into new component activation by a document heading.
contract.customer_details: Customer values and sources override exact existing detail keys; explicit unknown detail is retained without catalog fallback. No new global canonical parent/enum/alias.
contract.deselection: Fresh checkbox removal removes proof and five addon rows; stale IDs/catalog rows cannot resurrect choice.
contract.display: Same scoped resolver controls component activation and selected addon display in manual context; raw evidence retained.
contract.source_scope: Pure document flows without internal catalog/manual context, including document-origin addon source references, retain previous behavior; 144 full pipeline snapshots remain exact.
contract.combinations: Smart/rot choices and facts retain their own strict proofs. All 202 other manual products and six non-rental target controls are baseline-identical.
contract.meaning: Manual choice is registration, not certificate proof or entitlement; terms still require rental registered in certificate. Premiums/general deductible, house rental-loss base, HTU and source meaning untouched.
